title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to work remotely near the Roanoke, Shreveport, Columbus, Tulsa, Corpus Christi, Abilene, Ft. Wayne areas.
This remote position offers a variety of great benefits, including health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, and long-term career growth opportunities.

Job Summary:
The Talent Acquisition Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across all areas of the Talent Acquisition department. This role ensures a smooth hiring process from interview scheduling to onboarding and post-employment activities, with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and a positive candidate experience. The position works under moderate supervision with limited independent judgment.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition Specialists to ensure an efficient, effective, and compliant staffing process that delivers a positive candidate experience.
  • Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates, hiring managers, and interview teams.
  • Arrange candidate travel and process reimbursements when required.
  • Guide candidates through the hiring process, ensuring timely completion of applications, new hire paperwork, and I-9s.
  • Audit hiring documentation for accuracy, completion, and compliance.
  • Conduct new hire orientation at assigned locations.
  • Schedule and track drug tests, physicals, and background checks, monitoring progress and results.
  • Manage on-site files, including historical I-9s and requisition documentation.
  • Administer or assist with employment tests as needed.
Minimum Requirements:
  • An associate’s degree in a related field is preferred.
  • Three years of experience in Talent Acquisition or a related administrative field.
Competencies & Skills:
  • Strong customer service focus with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to create a welcoming, professional experience for candidates.
  • Technologically proficient with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative team player with strong prioritization and problem-solving skills.
Additional Information:
  • Work Designation: Remote
  • Candidates must reside within the company’s operating footprint and within 50 miles of a facility location (examples: Roanoke, Shreveport, Columbus, Tulsa, Corpus Christi, Abilene, Ft. Wayne).
  • This is an office-based administrative position; no vehicle or machinery operation required.

About Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS):
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is an international recruiting and staffing firm specializing in Engineering, Technical, and Professional positions. Founded in 1984 as a subsidiary of an engineering firm, ITS continues to serve as a strategic partner for job seekers and employers alike.
Our clients include some of the largest and most respected architectural, engineering, and manufacturing companies in business today. Our ability to offer a wide range of services—and the flexibility to adapt to the evolving needs of our clients—has allowed us to maintain a strong reputation for several decades.

title: Real Estate Records Coordinator
description:
About the Role

Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Real Estate Records Coordinator to join our client’s team in the Columbus, OH area.
This direct-hire position offers excellent long-term benefits and the opportunity to work with a respected utility and energy organization.

In this role, you’ll help manage and organize all real estate records — including deeds, leases, easements, and surveys — ensuring everything is accurately documented and maintained in the company’s electronic land records system. You’ll support the Legal and Real Estate teams by tracking property ownership, processing payments, and maintaining accurate records for all company-owned and leased properties.

  • Provide support to Power Plant operations by maintaining accurate and organized property and lease files.

Qualifications

  • Education: Associate degree in Land Records Management, Real Estate, Business, or Paralegal Studies; or a Paralegal Certificate with 3+ years of experience in:

    • Real estate title research or abstracting

    • Commercial real estate or a related field

  • Preferred: Notary Public certification

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and database systems

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Strategic Sourcing Specialist – Procurement
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Specialist to work onsite at our client’s headquarters in Downtown Columbus, Ohio.

This full-time, long-term position offers excellent benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off.
Position Summary

We are looking for a sourcing professional with strong RFP sourcing experience, along with hands-on experience redlining and negotiating contracts.
This role requires excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to lead sourcing events with multiple stakeholders, primarily for technology-based software and hardware solutions.
As a Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will serve as a subject matter expert in developing sourcing strategies to support the procurement of labor, services, materials, and equipment. You’ll apply proven negotiation techniques, manage supplier relationships, ensure contract compliance, and help drive category management strategies that align with company goals.
Essential Job Functions
  • Procure goods and services with high-value or complex requirements.
  • Assess business needs and develop procurement plans that align with project and departmental goals.
  • Execute sourcing strategies based on category manager guidance and industry best practices.
  • Support Category Managers in the development and execution of category strategies.
  • Conduct market, supplier, and spend analyses to inform sourcing decisions and competitive RFX solicitations.
  • Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams during sourcing events and evaluations.
  • Develop negotiation strategies and lead contract negotiations, including redlining and risk management.
  • Draft and finalize contracts outlining pricing, performance criteria, and business requirements.
  • Maintain strong relationships with internal business partners and suppliers to support ongoing sourcing strategies.
  • Ensure alignment between procurement, Service Center, and customer support operations.
  • Oversee delivery, transportation, and storage logistics for high-value equipment and materials.
  • Manage contract compliance, including price adjustments, credit programs, and replacement terms.
  • Identify and mitigate risks while maximizing contract value and supplier performance.
Minimum Requirements

Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field; or 6 years of relevant equivalent experience.
Experience:
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience, including collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience in RFP sourcing, contract negotiation, and redlining.
  • Experience in supply chain category management within the utility, manufacturing, or construction industry is preferred.
Other Requirements
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Ability to lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders and suppliers.
  • Skilled in developing and improving category management processes.

title: Engineer Associate
description:
New Albany, OH | Onsite | Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM

Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking an Engineer Associate to work in the Tulsa, OK area. This position offers a variety of great benefits, including health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off.

Position Details:
  • Full-time, onsite role (five days per week)
  • Flex schedule available (limited rate flexibility)
  • Associate-level candidates only
  • 12-month contract
Job Summary

The Engineer Associate will accurately model transmission system topology, including impedance and facility ratings for lines, generators, and transformers at Medium, High, and Extra High Voltages using internal modeling databases, PSS/E, and/or ASPEN OneLiner. This role supports Engineering and Operations teams by fulfilling system modeling requests submitted through ServiceNow, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to model planned projects, and building power flow and short-circuit models representing the future transmission system. The Engineer Associate will also perform electrical transmission analysis, protection system studies, and tasks related to NERC Compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities
  • Model transmission system topology, including impedance and facility ratings for transmission lines, transformers, generators, and breakers.
  • Support system modeling requests via ServiceNow from Engineering and Operations personnel.
  • Collaborate with teams to model projects, build power flow, and short-circuit model cases.
  • Perform analysis of electrical transmission systems and protection studies.
  • Support compliance-related activities tied to NERC standards.
  • Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve technical issues and improve processes.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience modeling transmission and generation system topology using ASPEN OneLiner and/or Siemens PSS/E across Medium, High, and Extra High Voltages.
  • Proficiency in modeling:
    • Inverter-based generation (wind and solar applications)
    • Synchronous generation
    • Transmission lines, transformers, and circuit breakers
    • Fault studies and circuit breaker duty analysis
  • Experience with NERC Compliance standards and reporting.
  • Proven ability to improve and implement processes, including documentation and training.
  • Strong data validation and cleanup skills, comparing and verifying information from multiple sources.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an ABET-accredited program.
  • Passing the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination is encouraged and preferred.
  • Acceptable alternatives:
    1. Non-ABET Bachelor’s degree in Engineering plus a Professional Engineer (PE) license in any U.S. state; or
    2. Non-ABET Bachelor’s degree plus a Master’s or PhD in Engineering from a university with an ABET-accredited Bachelor’s program.

  • Oversees team(s) to develop new methods and solve company-wide matters.

  • Responsible for creating and fostering a work environment that encourages employees to act with integrity and respect.

  • Preferred

5+ years management or enterprise department manager experience including application development.

title: Environmental Health and Safety Coordinator
description:
ITS has a client in the Victor, IA area seeking a EHS Coordinator.  This is a direct hire position with full benefits including 401k. 


Job Responsibilities: 
1. Ensure policies and procedures are consistently applied based on the principles of the Corporate and Divisional Health, Safety and Environmental Policy, as well as compliance with Federal, State and Local regulations, including OSHA, EPA and IDNR
2. Ensure a safe work environment by coordinating all safety activities to reduce workplace accidents and protect associates
3. Plan and coordinate internal and external safety training for all associates
4. Coordinate and attend all meetings and activities of the Safety and Ergonomics Committees and set direction for them to be successful
5. Provide counsel and support to associates and management on health, safety and environmental matters
6. Establish written safety standards and annually update and review these policies and procedures including annual leadership reviews
7. Evaluate safety and ergonomic issues in workstation design and layout and in the development stage of processes and equipment
8. Provide and maintain statistics to assist in continuous improvement in the area of workplace safety and loss control
9. Review all accident/incident investigation reports and provide leadership in developing and implementing corrective actions
10. Analyze loss control statistics using root cause analysis and make recommendations for continuous improvement
11. Coordinate the selection of personal protective equipment (PPE) and appropriate fit testing of such items while working with purchasing to obtain the best price and develop cost reduction strategies
12. Conduct monthly safety and environmental audits as required and report results to appropriate personnel
13. Ensure that the Health and Safety and Environmental portions of the action plan are completed in a timely fashion
14. Maintain a high profile with associates on the plant floor and be a strong advocate to ensure that associate safety and environmental concerns and issues are resolved in a timely manner
15. Encourage safety and housekeeping practices and lead by example
16. Promote and practice "safety first” by immediately addressing any hazards, defective equipment or unsafe conditions within the department
17. Work with worker's compensation carrier and occupational health providers for appropriate, timely closure of work comp claims
18. Monitor and coordinate drug testing policy and procedures
19. Follow and support operating principles Supervisory Responsibilities:

None Education and/or Experience:
• Post secondary education in safety engineering or equivalent experience in a manufacturing environment
• Three to five years experience in health, safety and environmental field, in a manufacturing environment Knowledge.

title: Digital Deliver Senior Manager of Retail
description:
The Digital Delivery Senior Manager translates business segment strategy into functional plans and guides execution for a cross-functional team responsible for designing, planning, building, and supporting a portfolio of global websites, applications, and mobile apps. The incumbent effectively cascades functional strategy of the applications, solutions, and digital capabilities centered around the domain of digital interconnected customer experience. They participate with senior management to establish strategic plans and objectives to ensure successful digital experiences for customers around the globe.

The Senior Digital Delivery Manager will lead the transformation of our Retail Color Services platform—powering over 5,000 retail locations with precision, consistency, and innovation. This role plays a key part shaping the future of color technology in retail, delivering a modern, cloud-native platform that ensures exceptional customer satisfaction through our in-store color matching and tinting systems. This position will be responsible for driving the architecture, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance solutions. The Senior Digital Delivery Manager will lead a team of engineers and collaborate closely with product, UX, and business stakeholders to ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across all retail touchpoints.

Responsibilities

WHAT THE ROLE WILL DO:

Leadership & Supervision

  • Strategic leader, Directs operational units.
  • Directs the activities of a functional area or multiple integrated departments through lower management.
  • Leads team(s) to develop new methods and solve complex matters.
  • Responsible for supporting the talent strategy through hiring, onboarding, learning & development, performance, succession planning, engagement, recognition, and inclusion, diversity, and equity practices.

  • Responsible for fostering a work environment that encourages employees to act with integrity and respect.

  • Responsible for setting employee objectives and expectations, monitoring and evaluating performance, providing meaningful feedback, and mentorship.

  • Responsible for supporting employee career development.

  • Contributes to development of strategies of a function or multi departments.

Knowledge & Application

  • Participates with senior management to establish strategic plans and objectives. Makes final decisions on implementation and ensures operational effectiveness.
  • Effectively cascades functional strategy and contributes to development of organizational policies.
  • Accountable for actions that impact function or multiple department budgets.
  • Works on complex issues where problems are not clearly defined and where fundamental principles do not fully apply.
  • Translates business segment strategy into functional plans and guides execution. Participates in corporate development of methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and people.
  • Ensures budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.

Collaboration & Interaction

  • Interacts with senior management, executives, and/or major customers which frequently involves negotiating matters of significance to the organization.
  • Reconciles multiple stakeholder views to drive business results.

This position is not eligible for sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, including conversion to H1-B visa.

Job duties include contact with other employees and access confidential and proprietary information and/or other items of value, and such access may be supervised or unsupervised. The
Company therefore has determined that a review of criminal history is necessary to protect the business and its operations and reputation and is necessary to protect the safety of the Company's staff, employees, and business relationships.

Qualifications

Education

  • Required
    • Bachelor's degree or higher in the Information Technology (IT) field. In lieu of a degree, at least 11 years of experience in IT
  • Preferred
    • Certifications and/or course work focused on Color Science.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT
  • 4+ years management or enterprise department manager experience including application development.

Preferred

  • Familiarity or experience with Color Science, Color Measurement Devices, and/or Colorant Dispensers in support of color matching services.
  • Experience in leading digital delivery teams utilizing Agile software delivery practices, to enable desired business capabilities as defined by business leaders within a Product Management framework.

  • Experience in leading application development using MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, and Headless), ensuring scalable, flexible, and high-performance solutions with an edge computing architecture.

title: Maintenance Specialist
description:

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Use instrumentation and tools necessary for diagnosing problems (volt/ohm meters, oscilliscopes, amp probes, pyrometers, tachometers, etc.) ultrasonic testers, computers.

  • Respond to emergency situations including the safety of plant facility and equipment.
  • Maintain or exceed current operation to meet safety, quality, housekeeping, and production standards.
  • May supervise and train the work of others within the same department.
  • Perform assigned special projects.
  • Assist in updating, developing, and improving preventive maintenance programs.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED education required. Technical vocational training or Associate's Degree preferred.
  • Strong electrical knowledge or electrician experience preferred.
  • Able to read electrical, hydraulic, circuits, and logic schematics.
  • Advanced understanding of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and PLC drawings and functions.
